e.title: nlp.js (AXA)
e.summary: AXA 开源 NLP 对话库（6587★）：多语言意图识别/实体抽取/聊天机器人构建框架
e.body:
nlp.js（axa-group/nlp.js，6587★，MIT）是 AXA 开源的 Node.js NLP 库：构建聊天机器人/对话助手的完整框架——意图识别（分类）、实体抽取、多语言支持（数十种语言）、词干化与相似度匹配，可接多种 NLU 引擎。对 RIAA：保险客服/理赔对话助手的前端 NLU 方案——大厂（AXA）开源旗舰；与 [[parsr]]（同组织文档解析）配套构成保险 AI 文档+对话组合；对比 [[insurance-llm-framework]]（LLM 路线）理解传统 NLU vs LLM 的取舍。

## 同类工具
[[nonlife-pricing-agent]]、[[fortran-from-r-packages]]、[[insurance-ebm]]

e.summary_en: AXA's open-source NLP library (6587★): multilingual intent recognition / entity extraction / chatbot-building framework
e.summary_hk: AXA 開源 NLP 對話庫（6587★）：多語言意圖識別/實體抽取/聊天機器人構建框架
e.body_en:
nlp.js (axa-group/nlp.js, 6587★, MIT) is AXA's open-source Node.js NLP library: a complete framework for building chatbots/conversational assistants — intent recognition (classification), entity extraction, multilingual support (dozens of languages), stemming and similarity matching, with pluggable NLU engines. For RIAA: a front-end NLU solution for insurance customer-service/claims conversational assistants — a flagship open source from a major insurer; pairs with [[parsr]] (sister document-parsing project from the same org) for an insurance AI document+conversation combo; compare with [[insurance-llm-framework]] (the LLM route) to understand the traditional-NLU vs LLM trade-off.

## Similar tools
[[nonlife-pricing-agent]]、[[fortran-from-r-packages]]、[[insurance-ebm]]
